submission.bindingBasis: The owner reports the Workspace source identity advanced after planning (ownerChanged: true). The planning-time digest e5d8008d... no longer necessarily matches the current exact source state. Per the owner action contract, workspace.close compares against one exact expectedSourceStateDigest; a mismatched planning digest fails not_committed. Since the owner explicitly signals the source identity advanced, the planning binding is stale and cannot be used to close. The correct path is to re-observe to obtain the new exact current digest, then close against that.
submission.rationale: The owner boundary evidence explicitly says ownerChanged: true and that Workspace source identity advanced after planning. The action contract allows workspace.close to compare-and-close against one exact expectedSourceStateDigest, and the planning-time digest is now stale. The contract also states "after re-observation a caller may close against the new exact current digest." Therefore the planning binding is no longer valid, and we must re-observe to obtain the current exact digest before closing. Attempting to close with the stale planning digest would fail not_committed (or be rejected).
